question: Which areas the original's invasion ranking scores for Italy, against OpenHOI3's 24.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas
addresses.comment: **Rebuilds the ranked areas to invade at CEU3AI +0xC8** (nodes {area, score, distance, prev +0xC, next +0x10, byte +0x14}, kept by descending score through 0x49C240). Read whole, 0x895530 to `ret 8` at 0x8971B2. The list is freed first; nothing more unless UnitList_SumTransportCapacity(country units +0xBAC) >= 4 x infantry_brigade weight/1000. Candidates: an AI country takes every area (CCountry +0xD30) of every country in its enemies list (+0x1008) that is in_scenario, the area not landlocked - except that GER, when COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea (0x7FD90) says its acting capital's area borders an enemy, considers only NOR, SWE, FIN, DEN; and when both we and the enemy are in a real faction (slot 7), never FIN and never the acting capital area of ROM, BUL or YUG. With an agent: the areas of the agent unit's plan objectives (CUnit +0x234) that are real, not ours, held by a friend or an enemy, not landlocked and holding none of the agent's front provinces (+0xC0). Reach: our areas, plus every non_hostile_countries (+0xF98) country's areas unless our capital's area borders an enemy; range 2000 if it does, else 5000. For each candidate A (controller C): over its non-landlocked neighbour areas B - B ours: A 'touches us', and B (unless our acting capital's area) goes on a list of staging areas; B held by X != C where A is C's acting capital area, X a friend (IsFriend false-flag), at war with C (or REB, or an undeclared war covering B's first province), not played, in our faction where both are in real ones, B's region group not our capital's, and (X our subject, or we are not JAP and X not JAP/POL/DEN, X no one else's subject): A 'touches us' and B is a staging area. Then: A in the failed list (+0x94) skips; an AI country's A that touches us goes on the failed list; CEU3AI_MayInvadeArea false -> failed; some port of A must reach (0xD52A0, flag 0) a port q of a reach area within range (int(float(naval distance/1000)) < range), q in our area, in ENG's acting capital area, or reachable within range from one of our own ports - else failed. Score: 100001 for an area holding a priority province (+0x118); else, a small island (ports' level_max summing >= 1, < 5 provinces, no land neighbour +0x3C) gives GER -99 before 1944 and otherwise 10 x port levels + 51; C's acting capital area gives min(provinces,100) + 1, halved when C is a subject; else 1. +900 for C = GER when the Soviet Union owns provinces and has surrender progress > 300 or manpower < 90, we being major or max_ic > 100, and A GER's capital area; USA vs JAP +200 (+600 more for a small island) unless that Soviet test held; JAP: vs USA small island +600, HOL +200, PHI +100. Then g = 120 for each of the map defines GIBRALTAR_BLOCKER and SUEZ_BLOCKER whose province lies in A (ENG and USA only), plus over A's first 60 provinces: 8 x naval base level_max, +40 with victory points, +30 yielding crude oil/metal/energy/rare materials, +40 with a strategic resource (+0x18 slot 14), +5 owned by us; g / (n/20) when n/20 > 1. total = g + f; k = max(fistp(total/5), 5) (6 or more kept); score = total + MT19937Next(AI generator) % k, divided by (0x81880(A, our capital area)/200) when that is positive, rounded by fistp. Kept to 10 by dropping the tail. Then staging areas: the priority areas held by a same-side or non-hostile (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) non-enemy country are added; each not failed must pass AreaPair_SeaRouteOpen (0xD5760) (some port of our capital area reaches one of its ports while we are at war; always at peace) or goes on the failed list; one of ours needs >= 40 provinces in enemy-held neighbour areas (25 when one of them is its controller's capital area); score 500, or 10500 for a priority area, + AI-generator draw % max(fistp(score/5),5) - 5 x provinces, x2 for a controller's acting capital area; inserted with distance 0. Finally, entries scoring under the head's score / 10 are dropped from the tail. **Its draw (0x496A0B) is MT19937Next on the game state's +0x124**, the AI's generator and not the static one battles draw on (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59). **The staging step and the final cut read on the listing, 2026-11-14** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 89): the priority areas are those of +0x118's provinces in first-seen order (0x495AFA); the holder test is IsSameSide or co-belligerent (CDiplomacyStatus +0x58) and not IsEnemyTag, rebels skipped (0x496B42); the own-area count is of neighbours at war, rebels or under an undeclared war covering their first province (0x496D1D); s = 500.0 or 10500.0, k = max(fistp(s/5.0),5), the draw inline (0x496F5A, signed), less 5 x provinces, x2.0 for the holder's acting capital area (0x497026), fistp, distance 0. The final cut pops the tail while more than one is left. Seen: Britain at the start of Ireland1939_09_06_18 ranks France's area alone at -1926 (309 provinces), Germany's capital area failed for touching France's. **The score's arithmetic, read on the listing 2026-11-15** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 100; 0x89634E-0x896A88): every step is worked in double and stored as a float - f starts at 1.0, the subject's halving is x 0.5 and keeps the half, and each of the bonuses is added so; g starts at the blockers' 120s and takes each province's 8 x level (whole levels, as an int) and its 40, 30, 40 and 5 in turn, the 30 where any of the province's current_producing (+0x268) goods 3 to 6 - crude oil, metal, energy, rare materials - is not nought. The province counter is raised before it is tested, so it stops at 61 on a long area and is the province count on a short one; g is divided by counter / 20 (an int) only where that is above 1 - an area of 21 to 39 provinces is not scaled at all, one of 60 or more by 3. k = fistp(float(total / 5.0)), 5 unless above 5; the draw's remainder is idiv's, signed; the distance divisor is the least port distance / 200 as an int; the score is the float sum divided in double, then fistp, half to even. Seen: the Soviet Union at 04:00 on 17 July 1941 ranks Bornholm 70, Tromso's area of 108 provinces 31 and Hammerfest's 10. **Its candidates seen on the running game, 2026-11-16** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 105): after the draw (0x496A10) the area being scored is [esp+0x24]; Italy at 08:00 on 16 July 1941 scores five - 5139, 5191 and 5359 of Britain, 5379 and 14154 of Greece - where a reach test taking any fellow fighter's port as a place to sail from would score 24, Britain's own and Canada's among them: a friend's port counts only where an own port reaches it under the range.
addresses.evidence: A breakpoint at 0x496A10 logging [esp+0x24]'s first province ([[area+0x24]]+0xD0) and province count (+0x2C) and the draw, with ProcessAI's entry for the country, from Ireland1941_07_16_07: Italy's five at 60807872, Canada's eleven beside them. What would show it wrong: an Italian candidate scored at that hour beyond the five.
